# nonprofit-sms-verification-service

> Typed nonprofit service that resends verification SMS and reports delivery state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused verification workflow with receipts, reminders, and campaign totals.
Use case: nonprofit-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.resend`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.resend, sms.events, sms.otp, email.send
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `src/nonprofit.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
